= Reversed list fallback

Nested reversed lists count up too:

[%reversed]
. Three
.. Nested
[%reversed]
... Deep B
... Deep A
. Two

A reversed Q&A list:

[qanda%reversed]
First question?:: First answer.
Second question?:: Second answer.

A markerless list shows no numbers, so it has no warning:

[unnumbered%reversed]
. No marker
. Still none
